thread:
Maria L: FYI — planned maintenance for cohort saturn-3 this Sunday 03:00 UTC. Netstack hotfix + kernel micro-patch. Expect staggered node drains across the rack, ~2h window. Low customer impact predicted but posting early.
Alex P: ETA on first drain? any GPU pool eviction/interruptible work we should preempt?
Maria L: First cordon at 03:00, first node drain 03:05. We'll throttle to 1 node every 3m to avoid large kv-cache cold starts. Interruptible jobs will be evicted per usual.
Sarah O: I'll be oncall that window. Can you add the short checklist (backfill pools, kvseed) and a runbook pointer?
Maria L: Added runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/netstack-hotfix (short checklist at top). Backfill plan: promote standby-pool-saturn for 10% extra capacity during window, then scale down.
Sam R: Cost impact? if we keep standby at +10% for 2h what rough delta?
Maria L: Rough calc: standby GPUs are RTX-class, ~$0.45/hr each. For +10% (approx 4 GPUs) for 2h => ~3.6$ plus small network overhead. We'll absorb on ops budget.
Alex P: Any model-serving routes pinned to these hosts? need to re-route before draining?
Maria L: No pinned tenants. Routing: smart-router will shift traffic off drained nodes automatically. We'll pre-warm kv cache on promoted nodes for 15m before first drain.
Sarah O: Leave a slack ping 10m before first cordon and 1m before each cohort drain? I can cutover alerts.
Maria L: yes. I'll post reminders. Also enabling conservative batch sizes for model endpoints during the window to avoid latency spikes.
Alex P: Can we include the drain command snippet for SRE-run?
Maria L: sure — paste below:
```
# dry-run drain for node
./kube-drain --node saturn-3-node-04 --timeout 900 --evict
# actual: remove from pool, run healthcheck, then reboot
```
Sam R: Will the canary (saturn-3-node-01) be human-verified after drain or auto-pass?
Maria L: Canary is human-verified. I'll do a quick smoke (latency, error-rate, cpu/gpu temp). If smoke passes, continue with automated cadence.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: cohort saturn-3 netstack-hotfix — starts Sun 03:00 UTC (created by Maria L).
Sarah O: tagging @support for a heads-up to customer success in case of any unexpected regressions.
Maria L: thanks — support notified. After action: we'll run a short latency regression test and post results in #incidents if any anomalies.
Alex P: One more — is there an egress path change? last time we saw transient spikes when BGP changed.
Maria L: No BGP changes this time. We're only touching NIC driver micro-patch + kernel minor. Still, we'll monitor egress queues closely.
Sam R: ok. I'll run a quick capacity sim on staging to double-check backfill behaves as expected.
Maria L: appreciated. Final run: Sunday 02:45 UTC reminder, 02:55 UTC 10m warning, 03:04 UTC 1m warning.
Sarah O: perfect. I'll be in the channel and ready to escalate. :thumbsup:
